title: The Lantern in Grandmother's Garden
subtitle: An Evening Adventure in Grandmother's Garden
units: metres, y-up, default camera looks toward -z, +x is the viewer's right
description: Join Aman and his sister Tara on an evening visit to their grandmother's garden as they discover butterflies, wind chimes, and solve the mystery of a loose lantern battery cover.

segments.label: Garden Establishing
segments.description: Wide shot of grandmother's garden at sunset: house, path, pond, flowers, stone, and wind chime.

segments.label: Characters Enter
segments.description: Aman and Tara enter through the wooden gate. Aman carries a glowing lantern.

segments.label: Two Butterflies
segments.description: They stop at a flower where exactly two butterflies are resting.

segments.label: The Wind Chime
segments.description: A melodious wind chime rings on the right side of the garden. Tara and Aman turn to listen.

segments.label: Exploring the Garden
segments.description: Tara explores toward the vegetable patch while Aman walks toward the stone pond.

segments.label: Lantern Goes Out
segments.description: The sky darkens into night. As Aman returns, the lantern suddenly turns off.

segments.label: Investigating Problem
segments.description: Aman turns the lantern and finds the battery cover loose. It slips off and lands by the stone.

segments.label: Searching with Flashlight
segments.description: Tara turns on her phone flashlight, and they search the flowers, pond, and path.

segments.label: Finding the Cover
segments.description: Tara spots the battery cover beside the large stone, and Aman picks it up.

segments.label: Repairing the Lantern
segments.description: Aman attaches the cover and clicks the switch. The warm lantern light returns.

segments.label: Return Home
segments.description: Guided by the lantern light, they walk safely back to the house as the chime sounds again.

conditions.name: Interactive
conditions.interaction: 6 checkpoints; story pauses until the glowing target is selected

conditions.name: VR Immersive
conditions.camera: user-controlled look (drag, gyro or WebXR headset) on a fixed story rail
conditions.interaction: gaze/dwell glints on story objects; no free exploration

lines.text: One evening, Aman and his sister Tara visited their grandmother's garden. Since it was getting dark, Aman carried a small lantern.
Near a flower, they stopped. Two butterflies were resting on it.
Tara walked toward the vegetable patch, and Aman walked toward the pond.
Tara switched on her phone flashlight, and they began to search.
With the lantern working again, Aman and Tara returned home.

scenes.title: Garden establishing
scenes.visual: Wide shot of the grandmother's garden at sunset fading to evening: house, path, pond, flowers, vegetable patch, stone, wind chime, trees.
scenes.audio: Evening ambience, insects, light wind, very soft wind chime.

scenes.title: Characters enter
scenes.visual: Aman and Tara enter through the gate. Aman carries a small lantern.

scenes.title: Two butterflies
scenes.visual: They stop at a flower with exactly two butterflies. Aman points; Tara watches.

scenes.title: The wind chime
scenes.visual: TING, TING. Tara turns toward a wind chime on the right side of the garden. Aman looks too.
scenes.audio: Wind chime from the right (spatial in C2/C4).

scenes.title: Exploring
scenes.visual: Tara goes to the vegetable patch, Aman to the pond. Then both turn back.
scenes.audio: Footsteps; pond ambience near the pond.

scenes.title: Lantern goes out
scenes.visual: Sky darkens. Aman walks back to Tara. CLICK. The lantern goes out.

scenes.title: Investigating
scenes.visual: Close-up: Aman turns the lantern and finds the battery cover loose. It slips off.
scenes.audio: Soft tink as it lands by the stone.

scenes.title: Searching
scenes.visual: Tara switches on her phone flashlight. They search flowers, then pond, then path.
scenes.audio: Flashlight click near Tara; footsteps; distant chime.

scenes.title: Finding the cover
scenes.visual: Tara spots the cover beside the large stone. Aman picks it up.

scenes.title: Repair
scenes.visual: Aman refits the cover, switches the lantern on. Light returns; Tara smiles.

scenes.title: Return home
scenes.visual: They walk to the house with the glowing lantern. The chime sounds again. Fade out.

recallUnderstand.correct: Find the cover → attach the cover → switch the lantern on → light returns

perception.question: Where was the battery cover found?

apply.question: Imagine you are using a small battery-powered lantern and it suddenly stops working. You notice that its battery cover is loose. Based on what Aman did in the story, what should you do first?
options: Check and secure the loose battery cover
Search for a phone before checking the lantern
Put the lantern in the pond
